note: PostgreSQL 16 / pg_cron 1.6.8 · 별도 임시 study DB에서 실측. jobid·runid·PID·시각·물리 파일명은 실행마다 달라진다.

location.sql:
SELECT current_database() AS connected_db,
       e.extname, n.nspname AS extension_schema
FROM pg_extension e
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = e.extnamespace
WHERE e.extname = 'pg_cron';
location.output:
connected_db | extname | extension_schema 
--------------+---------+------------------
 study        | pg_cron | pg_catalog
(1 row)

tables.sql:
SELECT table_schema, table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'cron'
ORDER BY table_name;
tables.output:
table_schema |   table_name    
--------------+-----------------
 cron         | job
 cron         | job_run_details
(2 rows)

columns.sql:
SELECT table_name, ordinal_position AS no, column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'cron'
  AND table_name IN ('job', 'job_run_details')
ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;

empty.sql: SELECT count(*) AS jobs_before FROM cron.job;

job.sql:
SELECT jobid, jobname, schedule, command, nodename, nodeport,
       database, username, active
FROM cron.job
WHERE jobname = 'storage-demo';
job.output:
jobid |   jobname    | schedule  |                         command                          |      nodename       | nodeport | database | username | active 
-------+--------------+-----------+----------------------------------------------------------+---------------------+----------+----------+----------+--------
     1 | storage-demo | 2 seconds | INSERT INTO public.cron_storage_heartbeat DEFAULT VALUES | /var/run/postgresql |     5432 | study    | postgres | t
(1 row)

run.sql:
SELECT runid, jobid, job_pid, database, username,
       status, return_message, start_time, end_time
FROM cron.job_run_details
WHERE jobid = (SELECT jobid FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'storage-demo')
ORDER BY runid DESC LIMIT 1;

effect.sql: SELECT count(*) AS heartbeat_rows FROM public.cron_storage_heartbeat;

physical.sql:
SELECT current_database() AS database, n.nspname AS schema,
       c.relname AS table_name, pg_relation_filepath(c.oid) AS internal_path
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'cron'
  AND c.relname IN ('job', 'job_run_details')
ORDER BY c.relname;

----------+--------+-----------------+------------------
